purpose: Dedicated imagery for the product-family cards on products.html and their category/related surfaces. Each file belongs to exactly one product family so no two catalogue cards share a visual. Kept separate from the shared scene images in assets/products/ that the hero, capability and project sections reuse.

conventions.name: family-slug.extension
conventions.size: 1600x1000 landscape (source is cropped with crop=entropy so the subject stays in frame; survey-safety.jpg is hand-cropped - see its note)
conventions.usage: Referenced by the productX keys in assets/asset-library.js. Do not point two families at the same file.

assets.note: Manually cropped from the full frame, not crop=entropy: the entropy crop cut the total station off the top. Keeps the instrument and the surveyor's head in frame.
